Everything here is linked from the Canvas posts or the session slides. Optional material is marked as such; none of it is required reading unless the course says otherwise. Links open in a new tab.

## Session 3 · Introduction to spatial regression

**Optional viewing (Canvas post):** Luc Anselin, *Applied Spatial Regression Analysis*, [the whole YouTube playlist](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yMwQ4MljEWc&list=PLzREt6r1NenlbfMWgHZ9aRpKgJQD1yE3p){target="_blank"}. *"These lectures provide a step-by-step introduction to spatial regression. They also cover more advanced topics that we will not have time to discuss in STA530."*

| # | Lecture | Relevance for STA530 | Where in the app |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Spatial Regression Specifications](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yMwQ4MljEWc&list=PLzREt6r1NenlbfMWgHZ9aRpKgJQD1yE3p){target="_blank"} | **Core**: lag and error models | [3.4](session3.qmd#t3-4) |
| 2 | [Spatial Process Models](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6F5u8GEPHzs&list=PLzREt6r1NenlbfMWgHZ9aRpKgJQD1yE3p){target="_blank"} | **Core**: what process each model assumes | [3.8](session3.qmd#t3-8) |
| 3 | [2SLS](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wqsHFbJqpB0&list=PLzREt6r1NenlbfMWgHZ9aRpKgJQD1yE3p){target="_blank"} | Beyond the course | [3.12](session3.qmd#t3-12) |
| 4 | [Spatial Durbin Model](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4zKe9owAu38&list=PLzREt6r1NenlbfMWgHZ9aRpKgJQD1yE3p){target="_blank"} | Beyond the course | [3.12](session3.qmd#t3-12) |
| 5 | [Spatial Spillovers](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C-sBZ9XWC9g&list=PLzREt6r1NenlbfMWgHZ9aRpKgJQD1yE3p){target="_blank"} | **Core**: direct, indirect and total impacts | [3.5](session3.qmd#t3-5) |
| 6 | [Specification Tests](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XyIokAi01Ko&list=PLzREt6r1NenlbfMWgHZ9aRpKgJQD1yE3p){target="_blank"} | **Core**: residual Moran's I, LM tests | [3.10](session3.qmd#t3-10) |
| 7 | [Robust Tests](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nWk2eBPEsR4&list=PLzREt6r1NenlbfMWgHZ9aRpKgJQD1yE3p){target="_blank"} | **Core**: robust LM tests | [3.10](session3.qmd#t3-10) |
| 8 | [Principles of Maximum Likelihood Estimation](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZeHNaM0N7rc&list=PLzREt6r1NenlbfMWgHZ9aRpKgJQD1yE3p){target="_blank"} | Beyond the course | [3.12](session3.qmd#t3-12) |
| 9 | [ML Estimation of Spatial Lag Model](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2YOlaEYhX8U&list=PLzREt6r1NenlbfMWgHZ9aRpKgJQD1yE3p){target="_blank"} | Beyond the course | [3.12](session3.qmd#t3-12) |
| 10 | [GMM Estimation Principle](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X8MFLAs5d3w&list=PLzREt6r1NenlbfMWgHZ9aRpKgJQD1yE3p){target="_blank"} | Beyond the course | [3.12](session3.qmd#t3-12) |
| 11 | [IV Estimation of Spatial Lag Model](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3xwYgtZIV4c&list=PLzREt6r1NenlbfMWgHZ9aRpKgJQD1yE3p){target="_blank"} | Beyond the course | [3.12](session3.qmd#t3-12) |
| 12 | [ML Estimation Spatial Error Model](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tD4o2_TLOv0&list=PLzREt6r1NenlbfMWgHZ9aRpKgJQD1yE3p){target="_blank"} | Beyond the course | [3.12](session3.qmd#t3-12) |
| 13 | [GMM Estimation of Spatial Error Model](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rBPncf4_sVg&list=PLzREt6r1NenlbfMWgHZ9aRpKgJQD1yE3p){target="_blank"} | Beyond the course | [3.12](session3.qmd#t3-12) |

"Core" means the lecture covers something STA530 teaches; "beyond the course" lectures cover what the session explicitly leaves out (estimation, IV/GMM, the Durbin model).

## Session 4 · Introduction to Bayesian disease mapping

| Resource | What it is | Where in the app |
|---|---|---|
| [Gómez-Rubio, *Bayesian Inference with INLA*](https://becarioprecario.bitbucket.io/inla-gitbook/){target="_blank"} | Free online book: latent Gaussian models, spatial models and their implementation in R. **Optional, not required reading**; the computational details of INLA are not expected | [4.21](session4.qmd#t4-21) |

## Course books

From the literature list (not online):

- Lawson, Banerjee, Haining & Ugarte (eds.) (2016). *Handbook of Spatial Epidemiology*. CRC Press. Main textbook.
- Anselin (2024). *An Introduction to Spatial Data Science with GeoDa, Volume 1: Exploring Spatial Data*. Chapman & Hall/CRC. Chapters 1–7, 10, 13 and 16.
